system: CRAFTING STATIONS (world placement, interaction gating, recipe/tier restriction, visuals)
summary: Crafting is 100% station-gated: the only way to open any crafting UI is a left-click on a CraftingStation (or a player-placed station entity) while standing within INTERACTION_RANGE=3.5 tiles. 20 free starter stations (5 types x T1-T4) spawn in a fixed grid north of world origin at world init; additional stations are craftable via smithing recipes and placeable from inventory by double-click. Station type exactly selects the recipe discipline; station tier caps recipe tier (recipe.station_tier <= station.tier), caps usable material tier in interactive mode, and sizes the placement grid/slots per discipline. Stations render as PNG icons (assets/items/stations/{name}_t{tier}.png) with in-range green border and T-label, falling back to a colored diamond. Clicking with no station under the cursor falls through to resource-harvest/attack; clicking a station out of range silently does nothing (no message).
player_facing: Open a station: single left-click on the station sprite in the world; click position is screen->world converted via camera center + TILE_SIZE (game_engine.py:2855-2856), station hit-test is a box |dx|<=0.8 AND |dy|<=0.8 tiles (world_system.py:1279-1294), then interaction succeeds only if player distance <= 3.5 tiles (character.py:884-885, config.py:184, character.py:1412-1415)

On successful click: regular crafting UI opens (crafting_ui_open=True), 'crafting' menu-open stat recorded, active grid tier captured, previous placement/recipe/scroll reset (game_engine.py:3031-3040)

Regular crafting UI: header '<TYPE> (T<n>)' in station color, recipe list filtered to that station type+tier, discipline-specific placement panel sized by STATION tier (renderer.py:5433, 5481-5482, 5505-5507, 5719-5735)

'Interactive Mode' button inside the crafting window opens the freeform interactive UI (recipe matching + LLM invention) for the same station type+tier (game_engine.py:2608-2613, 4412-4442); clicking outside either window closes it (game_engine.py:2602-2604, 2618-2622); ESC closes interactive first, then regular (game_engine.py:805-820)

Stations in the world: 20 starter stations spawn free near origin — columns x=-8 smithing, x=-4 refining, x=0 adornments, x=4 alchemy, x=8 engineering; tiers 1-4 at y=-10,-12,-14,-16 (world_system.py:671-692, called unconditionally at init world_system.py:133); startup tip text 'Crafting stations are right next to you!' (game_engine.py:11972)

Player-built stations: all 20 station items (forge/refinery/alchemy_table/engineering_bench/enchanting_table T1-T4) are craftable via smithing recipes (recipes.JSON/recipes-smithing-3.json e.g. smithing_forge_t2 line 663-664) and defined as placeable non-stackable 'station' category items (items.JSON/items-smithing-2.JSON, 20 entries); double-click the item in the inventory panel places it at the player's grid-snapped position if the square is unoccupied (game_engine.py:2688-2732, 2721-2757, 2785-2802)

Placed stations cannot be picked up by clicking — they must be broken with tools to recover (game_engine.py:2899-2900); they never expire (no lifetime bar drawn for CRAFTING_STATION type, renderer.py:1146-1147)

Station visuals: icon 'stations/{forge|alchemy_table|refinery|engineering_bench|enchanting_table}_t{tier}.png' resolved under assets/items/ (renderer.py:1038-1050, image_cache.py:21,62-64; all 20 PNGs exist in assets/items/stations/), drawn at TILE_SIZE*ENTITY_VISUAL_SCALE+8 px (renderer.py:1036, config.py:26) with green border in range / gray out of range (renderer.py:1057-1058); fallback = colored diamond in station color, dimmed -50 per channel when out of range (renderer.py:1060-1064, world.py:303-311); 'T<n>' label with black outline shown above only when in range (renderer.py:1066-1074)

No station nearby: there is NO craft-anywhere and NO hotkey to open crafting (only assignment of crafting_ui_open=True in the whole codebase is character.py:1415 inside interact_with_station); a world click that hits no station/resource/chest falls through to attack-toward-click (game_engine.py:2887-2893)
mechanics: Two coexisting station representations: (a) native CraftingStation dataclass {position, station_type: StationType enum, tier} in world.crafting_stations (world.py:296-311, world_system.py:72); (b) player-placed PlacedEntity with entity_type=CRAFTING_STATION which is converted on click to a temporary CraftingStation via a 40-entry item_id->StationType map (new ids forge_t1..enchanting_table_t4 + legacy tier_1_forge..tier_4_enchanting_table), unknown ids default to SMITHING, tier taken from placed_entity.tier (game_engine.py:2971-3029)
StationType enum values: smithing, alchemy, refining, engineering, adornments — note enchanting_table items map to ADORNMENTS, not an 'enchanting' type (world.py:287-293, game_engine.py:2997-3000)

Recipe gating rule: recipes_by_station[station_type] filtered to r.station_tier <= station.tier — exact type match, higher-tier station unlocks all lower-tier recipes of its own discipline only (recipe_db.py:149-150; consumed at renderer.py:5506-5507 and interactive_crafting.py:318,442,590,777,1044)
Interactive-mode material palette gated by material tier <= station tier (mat_def.tier <= self.station_tier), except debug mode shows 99 of everything (interactive_crafting.py:67-84)

Station tier sizes the crafting workspace per discipline: smithing grid T1=3x3/T2=5x5/T3=7x7/T4=9x9 (interactive_crafting.py:631-636; renderer.py:65,124-125); refining hub T1=1core+2surround/T2=1+4/T3=2+5/T4=3+6 (interactive_crafting.py:193-207); alchemy sequence slots T1=2/T2=3/T3=4/T4=6 (interactive_crafting.py:369-374; renderer draws max_slots=1+tier at renderer.py:604-605 — MISMATCH, see hazards); engineering slot types T1-T2=[FRAME,FUNCTION,POWER], T3-T4 add [MODIFIER,UTILITY] (interactive_crafting.py:495-510; renderer max slots {1:3,2:5,3:5,4:7} renderer.py:777-779); adornments shape grid T1=8x8/T2=10x10/T3=12x12/T4=14x14 with cumulative shape unlocks per tier (interactive_crafting.py:834-862)

Backwards compatibility: lower-tier recipe placements are centered into the larger station grid via offset=(station_grid - recipe_grid)//2 (game_engine.py:6639-6654, 6719-6738); validation allows extra unused slots when recipe_tier < station_tier (game_engine.py:6815-6833, 6860-6875, 6903-6918); smithing interactive matching tries recipes from current station tier DOWN to T1, skipping tiers whose grid is smaller than the placement bounding box (interactive_crafting.py:762-792)

Placement flow (player-built): double-click inventory slot -> mat_def.placeable check -> snap player pos to grid -> reject if get_entity_at occupied ('Square already occupied!') -> entity type from EngineeringTagProcessor behavior 'placeable_crafting'->CRAFTING_STATION, legacy fallback category=='station'->CRAFTING_STATION -> place_entity with tier=mat_def.tier, range and damage forced to 0.0 for stations -> decrement/remove inventory stack (game_engine.py:2721-2802)

Open interactive: requires character.active_station non-null else abort with console warning (game_engine.py:4416-4418); creates per-discipline UI via factory create_interactive_ui(station_type, tier, inventory), valid types smithing/refining/alchemy/engineering/adornments else None (interactive_crafting.py:1153-1178); success also preloads the ML classifier for that discipline in a background thread (game_engine.py:4438-4439, 4444-4455)
Craft completion XP scales with recipe station tier: quick-craft 20*station_tier (game_engine.py:7211), minigame path int(20*station_tier*1.5) (game_engine.py:9034)

Refining difficulty multiplies by station tier: station_mult = 1.0 + stationTier*0.5 using the RECIPE's stationTier (stationTierRequired fallback stationTier), not the physical station used (difficulty_calculator.py:348-352)

Persistence: native stations serialized as {position, station_type.name, tier} (world_system.py:1493-1502); on load a non-empty saved list clears and replaces the 20 defaults, empty list keeps defaults (world_system.py:1590-1606); player-placed stations persist through the placed_entities list with tier/health (world_system.py:1536-1564)
Close paths: click outside crafting window, ESC, or close_crafting_ui() which nulls active_station and flag (character.py:1417-1419, game_engine.py:805-820, 2618-2622, 4403)
data: Definitions.JSON/crafting-stations-1.JSON — LEGACY/backup station item defs, 12 entries only (forge t1-t4, refinery t1-t2, alchemy_table t1-t2, engineering_bench t1-t2, enchanting_table t1-t2); fields: itemId 'forge_t1', category 'station', type 'crafting', subtype 'smithing', tier 1-4, rarity, range 0, stats.durability [9999,9999], stats.weight 30-150, requirements.level (1/8/10/15/25), flags {stackable:false, placeable:true, repairable:false}, metadata.narrative+tags

items.JSON/items-smithing-2.JSON — PRIMARY station item source, full 20 entries (all 5 types x T1-T4), loaded first with categories=['station']; crafting-stations-1.JSON loaded second as backup (game_engine.py:150-155)
recipes.JSON/recipes-smithing-3.json — 20 recipes outputting every station item (e.g. recipeId 'smithing_forge_t2' -> outputId 'forge_t2' at lines 663-664); stations are smithing products

assets/items/stations/*.png — all 20 icons present (forge_t1..t4, refinery_t1..t4, alchemy_table_t1..t4, engineering_bench_t1..t4, enchanting_table_t1..t4); path built as 'stations/{name}_t{tier}.png' and prefixed with 'items/' by ImageCache (renderer.py:1047, image_cache.py:62-64)
world-generation config: spawn_area.crafting_station_area.enabled parsed into crafting_stations_enabled default True (world_generation_db.py:111, 266) — never consulted (see hazards)
constants: INTERACTION_RANGE = 3.5 tiles — sole gate on station use (config.py:184, character.py:884-885)
Station click hit-test tolerance = 0.8 tiles, per-axis box not Euclidean (world_system.py:1280-1293)
Starter station layout: x by type {-8 smithing, -4 refining, 0 adornments, 4 alchemy, 8 engineering}; y = -10 - (tier-1)*2 => -10/-12/-14/-16 for T1-T4 (world_system.py:677-692)
Craft XP = 20 * recipe.station_tier; minigame XP = int(20 * station_tier * 1.5) (game_engine.py:7211, 9034)
Station icon draw size = TILE_SIZE * ENTITY_VISUAL_SCALE + 8, ENTITY_VISUAL_SCALE = 1.0 (renderer.py:1036, config.py:26)

Station colors: smithing (180,60,60), alchemy (60,180,60), refining (180,120,60), engineering (60,120,180), adornments (180,60,180), fallback (150,150,150); out-of-range dim = max(0, c-50) per channel (world.py:303-311, renderer.py:1061)
Station item durability [9999,9999], range 0, stackable false, placeable true (crafting-stations-1.JSON:22-32)
Double-click window 500 ms (game_engine.py:2335-2337); dropped-item pickup range 2.0, chest click range 1.5 (game_engine.py:2906, 2942)
hazards: Out-of-range station click is SILENT: interact_with_station no-ops with no notification (character.py:1412-1415), yet the engine still records a 'crafting' menu-open stat, stamps menu-open time, and clears selected recipe/placement before returning (game_engine.py:3031-3040) — stat data is polluted and the player gets zero feedback (contrast: dungeon entrance gives 'Move closer' at game_engine.py:2967-2968)

Order-dependence in handle_mouse_click: UI windows -> inventory panel -> dungeon -> enemy -> dropped items -> chests -> dungeon entrance -> stations -> resources -> attack fall-through (game_engine.py:2284-3059); station check runs native list BEFORE placed entities (game_engine.py:2971-2976); porting must preserve this priority chain
Unknown placed item_id defaults to StationType.SMITHING at click time (game_engine.py:3023) — a mis-mapped station silently becomes a forge

Duck-typing/name trap: 'enchanting_table' items and JSON subtype 'enchanting' map to StationType.ADORNMENTS / discipline string 'adornments' (game_engine.py:2997-3000); the JSON 'subtype' field is never read for click routing — only the item_id map is

requirements.level in station JSON (8/10/15/25) is loaded but NEVER enforced anywhere — placement checks only mat_def.placeable + square occupancy (game_engine.py:2721-2732); a level-1 player can place and use a T4 forge
crafting_stations_enabled world-gen flag is parsed (world_generation_db.py:266) but never read; spawn_starting_stations() always runs (world_system.py:133) — dead config

Comment/doc vs code mismatch: difficulty_calculator.py:348 comment claims station mult 'T1=1.5x, T2=2.5x, T3=3.5x, T4=4.5x' (CLAUDE.md agrees) but the code computes 1.0+tier*0.5 = 1.5/2.0/2.5/3.0 (difficulty_calculator.py:350) — port the CODE, and note it also uses the recipe's declared stationTier, never the physical station's tier

Alchemy slot-count mismatch: interactive UI uses {1:2,2:3,3:4,4:6} (interactive_crafting.py:372) while the regular-crafting renderer computes max_slots = 1+tier = 2/3/4/5 (renderer.py:604-605) — T4 differs (6 vs 5); both exist in shipped behavior

Regular crafting placement grid is sized by engine field active_station_tier captured at click (game_engine.py:3036, 6640) while interactive UI carries its own station_tier — two parallel tier plumbing paths that must stay in sync

Station items live in TWO JSON files loaded sequentially (items-smithing-2.JSON primary, crafting-stations-1.JSON legacy backup, same itemIds for 12 of 20; game_engine.py:150-155) — loader dedup behavior determines which definition wins; keep load order

Native CraftingStations are indestructible, uninteractable-except-craft world fixtures; PlacedEntity stations have health and can be broken by tools for recovery (game_engine.py:2899, world.py:449-461) — two different lifecycles for the 'same' station

Save-load quirk: an empty crafting_stations list in the save keeps the 20 defaults, non-empty replaces them entirely (world_system.py:1591-1606) — a save made after mods removed all stations would silently restore defaults
get_station_at tolerance is a 0.8 per-axis box (Chebyshev-style), while chests/dropped items use Euclidean distance — do not unify (world_system.py:1290-1293 vs game_engine.py:2905, 2938-2942)

Debug mode (F1 / DEBUG_INFINITE_RESOURCES) bypasses BOTH material-tier palette filtering (shows 99 of every material at any tier, interactive_crafting.py:67-77) and can_craft material checks (recipe_db.py:152-158)
